scripts.test:e2e:rentals: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-smartwatts "playwright test --config playwright.rentals.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:nfc: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-smartwatts "playwright test --config playwright.nfc.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:demo: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.demo.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-smartwatts "playwright test --config playwright.demo.config.ts"
